text:
Alden: Kairos Edge asked for a 5-week POC to onboard their kairos-qlora-14b variant. Asks: custom BPE tokenizer with nonstandard merges, 4-bit qlora, embeddings for an internal reranker (2048-d), KMS + VPC, HIPAA compliance checks, and committed per-call pricing.
Marco: Catalog quick-check: we have kairos-14b-base in staging but no qlora variant nor their tokenizer. Need tokenizer.json + merges and a small sample corpus to validate token IDs and special tokens. If merges shift IDs we risk kv-cache alignment issues.
Tanya: Compliance note: HIPAA requires private deployment or strict data handling. If they will process PHI we should recommend Private (VPC/on-prem) and run the enterprise addendum. Also need business associate agreement (BAA) path. I'll pull the HIPAA checklist.
Zoe: Pricing primer: hosted PAYG ~ $0.010 / 1k tokens for this size; committed small dedicated pool estimate ~$3.8k/mo; embedding projection to 2048 will add CPU/GPU work and per-embed charge. Need expected token/day and embed call volume to firm numbers.
Alden: Action items: 1) Ask Kairos for tokenizer artifacts + 500-line sample. 2) If they confirm PHI, propose Private POC and surface BAA. 3) Run perf for 4-bit qlora vs fp16 baseline once tokenizer arrives.
Marco: Running a dry perf on the staging base (no tokenizer yet) to give ballpark:
```bash
redwood perf --model kairos-14b-base --quant 4bit --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 66ms/token
# p95: 290ms/token
redwood perf --model kairos-14b-base --quant fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 4
# p50: 58ms/token
# p95: 210ms/token
```
Marco: Note: 4-bit tail appears sensitive to sequence length; recommend prefix caching and smaller batch for chat. If their tokenizer adds >5 special tokens we should run a token-id diff to check kv-cache offsets.
Tanya: For HIPAA: if PHI present, require Private deployment + KMS key ownership in customer account. Also set log retention to 30 days by default for POC unless they request otherwise. Longer retention will trigger legal review.
Zoe: I'll draft three price options (hosted PAYG, 4-week committed pool, private POC with setup fee). Include an example for 200k tokens/day and 50k embed calls/day.
Alden: I'll request the artifacts and the security QS now. Also ask for expected RPS and whether reranker can accept 1024-d embeddings (we can project to 2048 but need to run eval).
redwood-ops-bot: Ticket RW-28288 created and assigned to #sales, #eng-ml, #eng-security.
Marco: If they share tokenizer I'll run token-id diff and a perf run with their tokenizer attached. I can also produce a small adapter to remap special tokens if needed.
Tanya: I'll attach the HIPAA checklist and BAA onboarding steps to the ticket.
Alden: Proposed POC timeline to Kairos: week 0 artifacts + security QS; week 1 tokenization validation + short embed eval; week 2 perf runs + cost modeling; week 3 integration; week 4 security sign-off + optional private deploy; week 5 handoff. Sending now.
Zoe: Adding note: if embed projection used, call latency expected to increase ~12-20% depending on projection method. We'll include that in the pricing doc.
Alden: Thanks team. Will update once artifacts arrive :thumbsup:
